# Glencoe Heating & Cooling

> From its base in Glencoe, Middlesex County, Glencoe Heating & Cooling serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (548) 761-2123  |  Email: contact@glencoeheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://glencoeheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Glencoe, Newbury, Mount Brydges, Wardsville, Melbourne, Appin
